app.title: Mirror
loader.check.driver.warn: Needs setup — use Fix USB permissions on the dashboard
loader.check.player.warn: ffplay not found — playback will be unavailable
loader.check.obs.warn: Not found — the OBS feed will be unavailable
loader.check.plugin.scanning: Looking for the Mirror Source plugin…
loader.check.plugin.installed: Installed — restart OBS to load it
obs.tooltip.installPlugin: Install the Mirror Source plugin first
obs.tooltip.startObs: Start OBS Studio to enable the feed
obs.tooltip.stop: Stop sending video and audio to OBS
obs.tooltip.start: Send video and audio to the OBS Mirror Source
player.tooltip.start: Open a player window with video and sound
settings.orientation.hint: For OBS, choose Landscape: the picture stays 16:9 and fills the scene. Then select the source in OBS and press Ctrl+F (Fit to screen).
settings.live: Orientation and audio change immediately, even while mirroring. Use headphones with the microphone, or it also records the phone's speaker.
logs.title: Activity
status.engine.needsDriver.body: One step lets Mirror talk to your phone over the cable. Plug your phone in first, then approve the system prompt.
stage.no-phone.title: Plug in your phone
stage.no-phone.body: Use a USB cable. There is nothing to switch on first: no developer options and no debugging.
stage.phone-found.title: {name} is plugged in
stage.phone-found.body: Connect to set up the link. If your phone asks which app to open, choose Mirror.
stage.ready.title: {name} is connected
stage.ready.body: Press Start mirroring. Your phone will ask for permission to share its screen.
stage.waiting-for-phone.title: Approve screen sharing on your phone
stage.waiting-for-phone.body: Tap Start now on the prompt. Video appears here as soon as you do.
stage.mirroring.title: Mirroring {name}
health.verdict.smooth: Smooth. Frames are arriving on time.
health.verdict.uneven: A little uneven. Some frames are arriving late.
health.verdict.lagging: Lagging. The picture is running behind your phone.
health.verdict.dropping: Dropping frames. The connection cannot keep up.
health.hint.lowerFrameRate: Try a lower frame rate, or the Balanced preset.
health.hint.lowerBitrate: Try a lower bitrate, or the Balanced preset.
health.hint.lowerQuality: Try the Light preset, or a different USB port or cable.
health.title: Stream health
health.idle: Frame rate, data rate and delay show up here once video is flowing.
health.rate.help: Video and audio coming over the cable.
health.delay.help: How much later frames arrive than at their best. Near zero is good; a rising number means the picture is falling behind.
quality.title: Picture quality
quality.intro: Pick one to start. You can fine-tune it below.
quality.appliesNext: Changes apply the next time you start mirroring.
quality.preset.light.hint: Easy on older phones and slow cables.
quality.preset.balanced.hint: Good for most phones. The default.
quality.preset.maximum.hint: Best picture. Needs a fast phone and a good cable.
